title: A Pharmacokinetic Evaluation of Two Nicotine Patches in Smokers
brief_summary: Bioequivalence study to confirm that a NTS with a polyisobutylene (PIB) adhesive from an alternative supplier delivers the same nicotine blood profile as that of the currently approved NTS with a polyisobutylene adhesive from the current supplier.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* BMI 19-27 kg/m2
* smokes \>10 cigarettes per day for preceeding 6 months

Exclusion Criteria:

* inability to stop smoking during study
